UIDQuery.description: GCS user id. gcs-distill maps it to storage.root_path/user-{uid}.
UIDQuery.name: uid

AvailableDevice.description: Worker telemetry uses MiB. Null means unknown, never zero. Only selectable=true cards may be selected in the UI; refreshing and validation do not reserve resources.

available.description: GCS node scheduling eligibility, not physical GPU idleness.

node_memory.description: Node RAM in GiB, from the existing Swarm node API.

batch_size.description: Per-round candidate cap; default min(max(target_records,4),2000). max_rounds*batch_size must cover the target.

max_candidates.description: Default 3*target_records; counts requested candidate instructions, not total teacher API calls.

target_records.description: Final distinct usable records after native filtering. A shortfall fails and retains partial artifacts.

DataSplitConfig.description: Ratios must sum to 1. All enabled partitions must contain at least one independent group. Group integrity takes precedence over exact ratios.

group_by.description: auto or dotted scalar field path. Prompt and image grouping always applies.

dataset_name.description: Actual dataset file name derived from file_path. Use this as the dataset name on detail pages.

file_path.description: Dataset file path. Import paths must come from /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill/datasets/candidates. Uploaded files are stored under /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill/datasets/uploaded/{dataset_id}/{filename}.

source_type.description: Dataset source type: import for registered candidate files, upload for frontend uploaded files.

uid.description: GCS user id. User storage is derived as /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill.

description.description: Dataset display description. Updating it does not move or rewrite the stored dataset file.

uid.description: GCS user id. Must match the existing dataset uid.
GCS user id used to derive /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill/datasets/uploaded.

DistillationConfig.description: EasyDistill 2 workflow. New runs default to data-only instruct_distill. Stored in training_config.distillation. Expansion defaults off, including native advanced-recipe expansion. Split applies after export normalization, before student training. Four instruction recipes also accept single-turn SFT messages by extracting user text when instruction is absent. Multiturn/tool/image conversations are not flattened.

field_mapping.description: Canonical target field to source field. Entire dataset is validated before creating a run.

model_template.description: Required for student training, for example qwen

parameters.description: Native EasyDistill 2 config overrides; input/output paths and selected teacher are managed by GCS

seed_limit.description: First N seed records; zero means all. Source JSON is fully parsed; only selected records undergo schema validation.

trainer_image.description: Required for student training; existing LLaMA-Factory runtime

summary.description: Actual job type, input/output counts, output dataset ID, model weights availability.

uid.description: GCS user id. User storage is derived as /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill.

items.description: Same length and order as data.items; numeric zero and boolean false are real scores.

description.example: 将教师模型蒸馏到轻量学生模型

uid.description: GCS user id. User storage is derived as /storage-root-jfs/user-{uid}/train-center/model-distill.

executor_nodes.description: Optional CPU data-generation workers. GPU selected_resources are used only for optional student training.

gpu_count.description: Derived from selected_resources[0].xpu_indices when omitted/zero. A provided positive count must match; data-only requests are normalized to zero.

selected_resources.description: Student training requires exactly one named node and at least one physical GPU index. No cross-node selection or automatic GPU-count-only selection.

SeedTemplate.description: Offline public format example. Never auto-registered as user business data. download_path is relative to the API base ending in /api/v1/.

SelectedResource.description: Manually selected gcs-v2 node and XPU devices.

extra_params.description: Model connection options; student training does not consume these fields.

model_id.description: ID from GET /models/student with ready=true; backend resolves the local pool path.

model_name.description: Student model name. Optional when model_id is provided; backend fills it from the selected local model.

model_path.description: Resolved user-private model path returned by the backend; input always uses model_id.

provider_type.description: Must be 'local' - system runs in offline environment

message.example: 获取学生模型列表成功

api_secret_ref.description: API key value; stored privately and redacted in responses. Do not resubmit the masked value.

concurrency.description: Positive values override existing recipe and stage settings; zero/omitted retains recipe defaults; negative values are rejected.

extra_params.description: EasyDistill passthrough params. Use extra_params.api_key to override api_secret_ref, and extra_params.inference for advanced inference fields such as stream, system_prompt, seed, trust_remote_code, max_model_len.

max_tokens.description: Positive values override existing recipe and stage settings; zero/omitted retains recipe defaults; negative values are rejected.

model_name.description: Model name. Required for api provider; optional for local provider when model_id is provided.

retry_attempts.description: Retries after first attempt for native generation operators. Some upstream evaluators retain their own policy; the three-consecutive-timeout circuit still applies.

service_id.description: Owned online model-center service; backend resolves endpoint, model and credentials.

supports_vision.description: null means unknown. Model configuration detection is not an inference probe.

max_length.description: Maximum training sequence length. If omitted: 4096 for Agent and multimodal workflows, 512 for other workflows. Explicit values are preserved.

num_train_epochs.description: Positive student training epochs; fractional values such as 0.5 are supported.

info.description: Offline x86 EasyDistill 2 data workflows and optional local student training. UID must be injected by the trusted platform gateway. Legacy local teacher inference is removed.
